items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 38:1
items.html: This was already explained in the previous parts, in the Partzufim of AK: every lower one fills the vessels of the body of the upper one, after its screen has been refined and the vessels of its body have emptied of their lights. Hence, in every Partzuf two kinds of vessels are discerned: the first kind are the vessels that already existed in the world, meaning the vessels of the body of the upper one that emptied of their lights and came to the phase of the lower one. The second are the vessels that emerge with the new coupling made in the phase of the lower one, for after the screen couples with the upper light and raises reflected light from below upward to the phase of the ten Sefirot of the Rosh, it then inverts and expands into ten Sefirot from itself, from above downward, to the phase of the vessels of the body. These vessels are new vessels that did not yet exist in the world, having emerged now by force of the coupling, as explained. In the Partzufim of Atzilut, the vessels that already existed in the world are called by the name BON, and the new vessels by the name MA. (Item 7)
